title: Points Redemption Credit: Computation — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Open repair order.** The open repair order is the repair order of the latest labor charge on the Service Accounts and Repair Orders account, and the redeeming vehicle is the vehicle on that labor charge. Wherever a record is chosen as the latest of its kind and two such records share that date, the one listed first in the records counts. Where the account carries no labor charge there is no open repair order and no redemption credit.

**Clause.** The redemption credit is the redeemable points times the value of a redeemed point, never more than the tier's largest redemption share of the open repair order's customer-pay labor and parts charges, rounded half up to the cent. The redeemable points are the whole points balance on file. A redeemed point is worth the tier's point value from the points terms.

**Assembly.** The amounts are assembled in this order: first every bonus rate this policy sets out is added into one rate and applied once to the redeemable points times the value of a redeemed point; then every dollar credit this policy sets out is added; then the cap on the open repair order is applied to that sum; and the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, point value 0.01, largest redemption share 50%)
| Points balance on file | Open repair order's customer-pay labor and parts | Points value | Cap | Redemption credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3460 | 412.30 | 34.60 | 206.15 | 34.60 |
| 9100 | 148.70 | 91.00 | 74.35 | 74.35 |
